text: Entry Requirements 1. 18-50 years old, good health. 2. High school graduate with good record or equivalent certificate.Those who have not graduated from high school,please submit a pre-graduation certificate,or a testimonial which shows your expected graduation time. 3. Language requirements for English-Medium Programs: TOEFL IBT 68 or above; IELTS 5.5 or above; 4. Other equivalent English language qualifications. Applicants who seek exemption from submitting one of the above English Language competency certificates for English-Medium Programs must show that they are: a citizen or permanent resident of an English speaking country(including countries with English as the official language,common language or native language).
